department: Doctoral Programme in Science (SCI), School of Science (incl. Applied Physics)

deadline.value: Continuous admission with roughly monthly cut-offs (nothing is processed in July); the last 2026 cut-offs are 3 Nov and 1 Dec 2026. Salaried doctoral researcher positions are advertised and applied for separately
deadline.quote: The Doctoral Programme in Science invites applications continuously (applications will not be processed in July). | Tue 3.11.2026 | Tue 1.12.2026

also.quote: Salaried doctoral researcher positions are applied for separately from the admission process to the doctoral programme.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: You must have a supervising professor in your intended research field before you submit the application
supervisor.quote: Before submitting the application, each applicant must have a supervising professor who is responsible in their intended research field to doctoral studies and the supervision of the studies.

funding.value: Not automatic: fund the PhD through a salaried doctoral researcher position (advertised separately) or grants. A full-time study right needs funding secured for at least 6 months; unfunded part-time study is possible in some cases. No tuition fees
funding.quote: Those applying for a full-time right to pursue a doctoral degree must have funding secured for at least 6 months (e.g. from the employer, or through project funding or a grant). | In some cases it is also possible to start pursuing doctoral studies without funding (part-time doctoral studies). | Most Aalto doctoral students combine different funding sources during their studies. | Aalto University doctoral studies are free of tuition fees.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree or equivalent; a degree from a non-Bologna country should normally include at least 4 years of study and a master's thesis
entry_route.quote: To be eligible to apply in doctoral admissions, you must have a relevant Master’s degree or equivalent. | As a rule, a higher education degree (or degree combination) earned abroad in a country that does not follow the Bologna Process should include a minimum of 4 years of studies and a master’s thesis.

notes: Physics is one of the fields of the Aalto Doctoral Programme in Science (School of Science, e.g. Department of Applied Physics). There are two routes: get a salaried doctoral researcher position first and then apply for the study right, or apply for the study right with other funding. The language rules are labelled for 2026 admissions, and the TOEFL minimum is given only on the old 0-120 scale. Cut-off dates for 2027 were not yet published. The Doctoral Programme in Science also covers the research fields Mathematics and Statistics, Computer Science and Neuroscience and Biomedical Engineering, with the same application process, so those fields are listed here instead of separate records.
